Problem Title:

Count Frequency of Each Character in a String

Problem Statement:

You are given a string consisting of uppercase and lowercase English letters.

Write a program to count the frequency of each character in the string and print the characters along with their frequencies in the order of their first appearance.

Character comparison should be case-sensitive
(i.e., 'A' and 'a' are treated as different characters)

Input Format:

A single line containing the string s

Output Format:

For each distinct character, print:

character frequency
(one per line, space-separated)
input_spec: A single line containing the string s
output_spec:
For each distinct character, print:

character frequency
(one per line, space-separated)
constraints:
1 ≤ length of string ≤ 10⁵

String contains only alphabets (A–Z, a–z)

No extra spaces in
